method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Global stocks climb, oil slides after pause in Middle East fighting
Equities.reason: Ceasefire/pause in U.S.-Iran hostilities and falling oil reduce geopolitical risk-premiums and energy-driven inflation fears, prompting a broad risk-on move in global equities. Important market-regime signal for near-term risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Stocks, Bonds Rise in Relief Rally as Oil Tumbles: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Multi-asset relief rally (stocks and bonds) reinforces a market-wide re-pricing of geopolitical risk and oil risk-premium. High relevance because it signals cross-market flow dynamics and liquidity/backdrop for equities.

Equities.title: Nvidia locks down memory supply from SK Hynix as part of $500 billion AI deal
Equities.summary: Nvidia is aggressively securing supply of high-bandwidth memory, an essential component for its GPUs and systems.
Equities.reason: Reinforces the dominant AI leadership theme: supply-chain moves by Nvidia support continued AI capex and hardware demand, underpinning tech sector concentration and positive flow into AI-related equities.

Equities.title: JPMorgan report finds dramatic jump in AI-themed ETFs — despite rough quarter
Equities.summary: Wall Street is banking heavily on exchange-traded funds that give investors artificial intelligence exposure, according to JPMorgan Asset Management.
Equities.reason: Shows persistent investor allocation into AI thematic products — a flow-based bullish support for the technology leadership narrative that drives index concentration and sector leadership.

Equities.title: Chinese chip champion CXMT soars 466% in market debut
Equities.summary: Tech group briefly becomes China’s most valuable listed company in mainland’s biggest IPO since 2010
Equities.reason: Huge IPO pop in a large China memory-chip name fuels risk appetite and local tech market momentum — important for China equity sentiment and EM tech flows, though partly idiosyncratic/froth-driven.

Equities.title: China industrial profit growth slows again in June as retreating oil prices sap earnings lift
Equities.summary: Corporate earnings have staged one of the strongest turnarounds in the economy this year, swinging from barely positive growth in 2025 to double-digit gains.
Equities.reason: Slowing industrial profit growth in China is a negative for China and EM equity risk sentiment and challenges the sustainability of the earlier earnings rebound — offsets some of the IPO/tech exuberance.

Equities.title: Big Tech Earnings Slam Into a Market in Revolt Over AI Spending
Equities.reason: Investor pushback on Big Tech earnings (concern over heavy AI capex vs near-term returns) is a material corrective narrative for US large-cap leadership—raises downside risk for concentrated indices and tempers rally optimism.

Rates.title: ECB to start implementing enhanced repo facility for central banks
Rates.reason: ECB operational step to add an enhanced repo facility should alleviate euro-area liquidity strains, supporting bond prices (yields lower). Material to rates/market functioning but not an outright policy-rate move.

Rates.title: Bond Traders on Edge as Risks of Fed Rate Hike This Week Mount
Rates.reason: Rising odds of a Fed rate hike are a direct negative for bond prices (yields up). This is a high-impact, market-moving narrative for global rates and risk premia.

Rates.title: Growing number of brokerages see July Fed decision as 'a close call'
Rates.reason: Brokerage positioning showing the Fed decision as finely balanced increases policy uncertainty and the chance of hikes — a negative impulse for bonds and supportive of higher yields/volatility.

Rates.title: Why bond investors are pushing up some of your interest rates
Rates.summary: Many types of consumer loans such as mortgages peg their interest rate to the yield on 10-year Treasury bonds, which has been moving higher.
Rates.reason: Explains transmission of rising Treasury yields into consumer borrowing costs — reinforces the prevailing narrative of higher long-term yields and its real-economy impact.

Rates.title: Indonesia faces test of central bank independence after governor's shock exit
Rates.reason: A shock central-bank leadership exit raises concerns about policy independence and could increase EM sovereign risk premia and local yields — negative for emerging-market debt.

Rates.title: Monetary policy decisions
Rates.reason: ECB policy communication/releases are central to euro-area yield dynamics; continued policy firmness or limited easing keeps yields supported (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: The Fed’s New Chairman Faces His Biggest Test Yet
Rates.reason: Leadership at the Fed and a high-stakes early decision increases market attention and perceived policy risk; tends to push term yields higher amid uncertainty about the policy path.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ guidance and Fed surprise risk steer the yen – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lee Hardman highlights that lower energy prices have eased pressure on Japanese policymakers and slowed USD/JPY’s climb below 164.00. Markets expect the Bank of Japan (BoJ) to keep rates unchanged but are focused on any hawkish signals on future hikes.
FX.reason: Lower energy and pause in USD/JPY momentum point to modest JPY recovery; BoJ guidance and Fed surprise risk are market-relevant but not decisive — moderate positive for JPY vs USD.

FX.title: Singapore tightens monetary policy in surprise move as rising oil prices rekindle inflation risk
FX.summary: Unlike most central banks, the MAS manages medium-term price stability by managing the Singapore dollar exchange rate against a trade-weighted basket of currencies.
FX.reason: MAS surprise tightening (via FX-band policy) is FX-native and supportive for SGD; meaningful locally but limited global FX transmission — small-to-moderate positive signal for non-USD currency strength.

FX.title: Euro: Energy risks cap recovery against US Dollar – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Francesco Pesole notes that EUR/USD has rebounded above 1.140 on lower Oil prices but argues the move looks optimistic without a clear de-escalation in geopolitical tensions.
FX.reason: EUR bounce on lower oil and risk-on is supportive, but ING flags geopolitical tail risks that could cap the rally — moderate positive for EUR vs USD.

FX.title: US Dollar: Fed communication key for path – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that markets have repriced the risk of a July Fed hike higher after Oil-driven inflation worries, but still expect no move.
FX.reason: Repriced Fed-hike risk is USD-supportive; Fed communication is a high-frequency driver for DXY and broad FX flows — material USD-positive signal (negative for non-USD currencies).

FX.title: ECB’s Kazimir: One more interest rate hike is needed
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member and Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS), Peter Kazimir, seems to be leaning towards a hawkish monetary policy outlook.
FX.reason: Explicit call for another ECB hike increases the odds of tighter euro-area policy versus the US — clear EUR-supportive macro signal with sizable FX relevance.

FX.title: Euro: September hike outlook offers support against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: UOB strategists highlight that EUR/USD slipped slightly to 1.1369 as comments from European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Gediminas Simkus suggested a rate increase remains more likely than a hold.
FX.reason: Market pricing of a September ECB hike is supportive for EUR/USD; a near-term policy-path driver with moderate relevance to FX markets.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: VCP breakout likely after Fed-BoE policy announcements
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) is up 0.15% to near 1.3345 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday.
FX.reason: Technical price-forecast piece signals a potential GBP breakout but is primarily technical; limited fundamental FX impact (kept relevance capped).

FX.title: British Pound: Fiscal risks cap upside against US Dollar – BNY
FX.summary: Geoff Yu at BNY argues that the Bank of England (BoE) is likely to keep policy unchanged despite energy-driven price pressures, as markets have already tightened financial conditions.
FX.reason: Fiscal uncertainty and a likely BoE hold act as a constraint on GBP gains versus USD — a negative GBP signal with moderate relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee recovers strongly amid steep decline in oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its recovery against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy week.
FX.reason: Oil-led improvement and regional de-escalation are supporting INR vs USD; meaningful EM FX reaction to commodity and geopolitical moves.

FX.title: British Pound: BoE seen on hold as risks linger – UOB
FX.summary: UOB strategists note GBP/USD edged up to 1.3326, with Gilts caught between fiscal risks from Prime Minister Burnham’s debut plans and the Oil price shock.
FX.reason: UOB view of a BoE hold plus fiscal and oil-related risks implies mild downside pressure on the Pound versus USD; moderate but not dominant.

FX.title: Australian Dollar advances to 0.7000 as Middle East de-escalation weighs on the USD
FX.summary: AUD/USD trades around 0.7000 on Monday at the time of writing, up 0.33% on the day, supported by a weaker US Dollar (USD) as geopolitical tensions in the Middle East show signs of easing.
FX.reason: Risk-on/reduced safe-haven flows after Middle East de-escalation have driven notable AUD strength versus USD — high relevance for commodity-linked FX flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Macro backdrop favors recovery against US Dollar - BBH
FX.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad anticipates the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will leave its policy rate at 1.00% after June’s hike, with inflation still below target and markets pricing only gradual tightening.
FX.reason: Macro factors and a slower tightening path priced in by markets leave room for JPY recovery versus USD; moderate relevance as part of broader JPY narrative.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Hawkish shift needed to aid JPY against US Dollar – BNY
FX.summary: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that the Bank of Japan (BoJ) is widely expected to keep rates unchanged, but stresses that markets need a clearer tightening signal as the Japanese Yen trades near multi-decade lows.
FX.reason: Commentary highlights that absent a hawkish BoJ shift, JPY is likely to remain under pressure — a noteworthy counter-signal to JPY-recovery views with moderate relevance.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Eases to 163.50 with the broader bullish trend intact
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) pares recent losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, favoured by a relief rally, as the US and Iran halted their hostilities, opening the door for further negotiations.
FX.reason: Technical/short-term relief driven move in USD/JPY after geopolitical easing — limited-relevance price-forecast signal.

FX.title: Dollar pulls back as US-Iran attacks pause, oil drops
FX.reason: Authoritative report that US-Iran pause and falling oil drove a broad USD pullback — high-impact, market-moving catalyst supporting non-USD currencies and risk-on FX flows.

FX.title: Euro gains strongly against US Dollar on revival of risk-on sentiment
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) trades 0.36% higher to near 1.1410 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday. The major currency pair trades firmly as the revival of risk-on market sentiment has diminished the safe-haven appeal of the US Dollar.
FX.reason: Risk-on revival is a clear driver for EUR/USD strength and reduced USD safe-haven demand — significant near-term positive for EUR.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: RBI inflow measures support against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank analysts report that USD/INR was little changed near 96.57 on Friday but has edged higher since early July, largely reflecting renewed upward pressure from Oil prices. They argue that the recent pullback in Oil should ease some strain on the Rupee.
FX.reason: RBI inflow measures combined with lower oil create a supportive backdrop for INR vs USD; meaningful for INR but modest for broader FX.

Commodities.title: Gold Climbs as Pause in Mideast Fighting Curbs Inflation Risk
Commodities.reason: Gold headline shows prices rising on a de‑escalation theme. Geopolitical risk/reflation dynamics are a clear driver for bullion — positive for gold with reasonably high relevance to the commodity complex.

Commodities.title: Gold extends range play below $4,100 as bulls keenly await Fed decision on Wednesday
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its consolidative price move through the first half of the European session on Monday and remains below the $4,100 mark as bulls seem hesitant ahead of the crucial FOMC meeting this week.
Commodities.reason: Intraday/technical price note ahead of the Fed — limited signal for structural commodity positioning; low relevance per framework (technical/price update).

Commodities.title: Energia Costa Azul, Mexico's second LNG terminal, shipped first cargo
Commodities.summary: Energia Costa Azul, the second liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facility in Mexico, shipped its initial cargo from Phase 1 of the terminal on July 8, according to the project developer. The completion of the project adds 0.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d
Commodities.reason: New export capacity increases available LNG flows — interpreted as a supply-side increase for the global gas/LNG complex, a negative for price direction with straightforward supply signal.

Commodities.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
Commodities.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 mill
Commodities.reason: Inventory build is a clear, conventional bearish signal for crude prices. EIA weekly flow data are high‑relevance fundamentals for the oil market.

Commodities.title: CPC Terminal to Resume Kazakh Oil Exports After Drone Pause
Commodities.reason: Resumption of CPC loadings restores supply flow from a regional producer — incremental bearish for seaborne crude availability and a tangible supply-side development.

Commodities.title: Oil slips more than 5% after US pauses strikes on Iran
Commodities.reason: Major market-moving wire: US pause in strikes materially lowers regional risk premium and triggered a sharp oil price drop. High relevance and clear negative directional impulse for crude.

Commodities.title: Oil: Mounting supply risks and price pressures – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank’s Charlie Lay notes that Brent and West Texas Intermediate (WTI) have pulled back after sharp gains, but underlying risks to Oil remain elevated. Escalation in the Persian Gulf and potential closure of the Strait of Bab al-Mandab are seen as key th
Commodities.reason: Bank commentary flags persistent upside risk from geopolitical supply threats despite the pullback — a relevant counter-signal that keeps volatility and upside-risk in play for oil.

Commodities.title: Oil: War risks keep prices volatile – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank's Senior Macro Strategist Benjamin Picton notes that Oil futures are lower after President Trump paused further strikes on Iran, reversing last week’s Brent surge above $100.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note: futures have pulled back but geopolitical premium remains, implying continued elevated volatility and intermittent upside — modestly positive for near‑term price risk premia.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $59.43 per troy ounce, up 2.26% from the $58.12 it cost on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Short‑term price update for silver; technical/market‑flow driven move with limited structural signal — low relevance per framework.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rallies near $60 as markets embrace US-Iran de-escalation
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) rallies on Monday and trades around $59.45 at the time of writing, up 2.27% on the day.
Commodities.reason: Price-forecast/near‑term note tying silver strength to geopolitical de‑escalation and metal correlations with gold — modest relevance (technical/near‑term forecast).

Commodities.title: China’s June gold imports via Hong Kong drop 5% from May
Commodities.reason: Physical flow data: a month‑on‑month drop in China gold imports is a negative demand signal for bullion and therefore relevant to gold price direction.

Commodities.title: Cocoa prices are easing. So why is chocolate still so expensive?
Commodities.summary: Chocolate firms look to win shoppers back with premium products and social media trends after poor weather conditions, tariffs, and the Iran war hit sales.
Commodities.reason: Article reports cocoa prices easing (supply/demand and weather/tariff dynamics). Cocoa is in the commodities universe; easing prices are a clear negative for the commodity.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin is back above $65,000 as U.S. and Iran hold fire. Oil drops 5%
Crypto.reason: Direct spot-price recovery for bitcoin back above recent highs — a clear bullish short-term signal. High market impact on crypto prices but a routine market-move story (daily momentum).

Crypto.title: A $5 billion cluster has formed in bitcoin options. It tells a bullish story
Crypto.reason: Concentrated options positioning and large notional clusters point to structural bullish flows and positioning — important derivatives signal for market regime and likely to amplify price moves.

Crypto.title: Crypto exchange BitMart to shut down after nine years, BMX token crashes 58%
Crypto.reason: Exchange shutdown is a material negative for industry trust, liquidity and token holders (BMX crash), and increases counterparty risk concerns — significant market-impact event.

Crypto.title: Poolin was bitcoin's biggest mining pool and now it's filing for bankruptcy
Crypto.reason: Major mining-pool bankruptcy raises miner solvency and network/settlement risk narratives — negative for crypto market confidence and potential short-term selling from distressed actors.

Crypto.title: EU hits Russia with massive 21st sanctions package targeting $120B crypto network
Crypto.reason: Aggressive sanctions targeting crypto flows amplifies regulatory scrutiny and enforcement risk for the sector; sizeable policy event likely to weigh on sentiment and trading activity.

Crypto.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank plans crypto trading infrastructure by December
Crypto.reason: Large traditional bank building crypto trading rails is an adoption/infra-positive development for market depth and institutional access—moderate constructive signal.

Crypto.title: North Korea arrests hackers accused of laundering stolen funds from country's bank via crypto
Crypto.reason: High-profile crypto-linked illicit activity increases AML/controls scrutiny and reputational risk for the industry — negative for regulation-sensitive flows.

Crypto.title: U.S. regulator warns prediction markets against cutting corners in event contracts
Crypto.reason: Regulatory warning signals tighter oversight and higher compliance costs for a subset of crypto markets (prediction/event contracts) — modestly negative for innovation and product launches.

Crypto.title: Crypto is the canary in the coal mine for the quantum computing threat, experts say
Crypto.reason: Longer-term technical risk to crypto cryptography from quantum computing; meaningful for strategic risk planning but low immediate market relevance.

Crypto.title: South Korea trading giant puts receivables onchain in tokenization test with LG CNS
Crypto.reason: Real-economy tokenization pilot by a large trading firm shows expanding enterprise use-cases and onchain settlement adoption — constructive for crypto utility narratives.

Crypto.title: Democratizing weather derivatives through tokenization could be crypto's most important real-world use case
Crypto.reason: Opinion piece highlighting practical DeFi / tokenization use-cases — supportive of long-term adoption but lower immediate impact (opinion format).

Crypto.title: Crypto's institutional influx has killed the memecoin craze
Crypto.reason: Narrative of institutionalization/market maturation reduces speculative memecoin froth — positive for longer-term stability and risk-on institutional flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin treasury companies sell up, repay debt, pivot to AI as share prices collapse
Crypto.reason: Corporate sellers of bitcoin to shore up balance sheets can create supply-side price pressure; material for market flows but somewhat idiosyncratic to treasury companies.

Crypto.title: Institutional crypto trading platform LMAX is exploring sale, IPO
Crypto.reason: M&A/IPO activity at institutional trading venues signals investor interest and potential liquidity/exit pathways — modestly constructive for institutional ecosystem.
